018package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
019
020import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
021import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.EMPTY_STRING;
022
023import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
024import java.util.List;
025import java.util.stream.Collectors;
026
027import org.apiguardian.api.API;
028import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.CustomTagletBase;
029import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
030import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
031import com.sun.source.doctree.UnknownBlockTagTree;
032
033/**
034 *  <p>{@summary This taglet is used to add an important note to the
035 *  documentation for an element.}</p>
036 *  <p>It does not allow the inline tags</p>
037 *  <ul>
038 *      <li>{@code @docRoot}</li>
039 *      <li>{@code @index}</li>
040 *      <li>{@code @inheritDoc}</li>
041 *      <li>{@code @link}</li>
042 *      <li>{@code @linkplain}</li>
043 *      <li>{@code @snippet}</li>
044 *      <li>{@code @summary}</li>
045 *      <li>{@code @systemProperty}</li>
046 *      <li>{@code @value}</li>
047 *  </ul>
048 *  <p>from the standard doclet. Custom tags that are not defined by this
049 *  taglet library will not work either.</p>
050 *
051 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
052 *  @version $Id: NoteTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
053 *  @since 0.0.5
054 */
055@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: NoteTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
056@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
057public final class NoteTaglet extends CustomTagletBase
058{
059        /*-----------*\
060    ====** Constants **========================================================
061        \*-----------*/
062    /**
063     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
064     */
065    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "note";
066
067        /*--------------*\
068    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
069        \*--------------*/
070    /**
071     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code NoteTaglet} instance.}</p>
072     */
073    public NoteTaglet()
074    {
075        super( TAGLET_NAME, false, Location.values() );
076    }   //  NoteTaglet()
077
078        /*---------*\
079    ====** Methods **==========================================================
080        \*---------*/
081    /**
082     *  {@inheritDoc}
083     */
084    protected final void customInit()
085    {
086        forceInit();
087    }   //  customInit()
088
089    /**
090     *  {@inheritDoc}
091     */
092    @Override
093    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
094    {
095        final var caption = tags.size() > 1 ? "Notes" : "Note";
096
097        final var retValue = tags.stream()
098            .map( v -> (UnknownBlockTagTree) v )
099            .map( UnknownBlockTagTree::getContent )
100            .map( v -> processTagContent( v, element ))
101            .map( """
102                
103                <li>%s</li>"""::formatted
104            )
105            .collect( Collectors.joining(
106                EMPTY_STRING,
107                """
108                
109                <dt><span class="simpleTagLabel">%s:</span></dt>
110                  <dd>
111                    <ul>
112                """.formatted( caption ),
113                """
114                
115                    </ul>
116                  </dd>
117                """ ) );
118
119        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
120        return retValue;
121    }   //  toString()
122}
123//  class NoteTaglet
124
